skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of derivative products and derivative markets; Apply knowledge of derivative trading in risk management.
Apply knowledge of derivative products in domestic and international markets for corporate financial management.
Analyze and price basic derivative products; Present investment strategies on derivative markets and risk management strategies using derivative tools.
Analyze and solve situations related to derivative stock investment in corporations; Analyze and solve situations related to risk management using derivative tools in corporations.
Enhance communication skills in a dynamic environment; Self-study and accumulate experience to improve professional expertise.
Develop critical thinking skills to solve practical problems related to derivative securities.
Develop skills to present and defend ideas in a group setting.
Develop the ability to self-study and complete assignments.
Manage time effectively to participate in class discussions and complete assignments.
Work collaboratively in a team setting to solve problems and complete tasks.
